title: Desktop Golden Path — Bridge Startup Flow
summary: Canonical flow of the desktop bridge startup sequence from frontend boot through WebSocket auth, projection delivery, and status rendering.

nodes.label: Frontend Boot
nodes.description: Browser/pywebview loads index.html and runs orchestrator.js

nodes.label: Runtime Config
nodes.description: Bridge injects runtime config with ws_url, handshake_id, and token_present

nodes.label: WebSocket Connect
nodes.description: Frontend opens WebSocket to /ws with Origin header

nodes.label: WebSocket Auth
nodes.description: Frontend sends auth message with token; bridge validates and returns auth_ok

nodes.label: Projection Sent
nodes.description: Bridge builds and sends full desktop projection

nodes.label: Projection Rendered
nodes.description: Frontend renders projection widgets in cockpit UI

nodes.label: Status Rendered
nodes.description: Status bar shows connected state with transport label

nodes.label: Idle / Ready
nodes.description: Cockpit awaits user input or agent activity

accessibility.alt: Flow diagram showing the desktop bridge startup sequence: Frontend Boot → Runtime Config → WebSocket Connect → WebSocket Auth → Projection Sent → Projection Rendered → Status Rendered → Idle/Ready.
accessibility.summary: Eight-step sequential flow from frontend boot to cockpit ready state
accessibility.long_description: This diagram shows the canonical desktop golden path. The browser loads the frontend, receives runtime configuration from the bridge, opens a WebSocket connection, authenticates with a session token, receives the desktop projection, renders the cockpit widgets, updates the status bar to show the connected state, and enters the idle/ready state awaiting user input.
